clarification_source: operator-authored finite public benchmark protocol; explicit JSON op/value semantics, independent oracle files are not task inputs

tasks.public_input: Implement JSON-lines handler using input objects {op:'sort',items:[{id:string,quantity:integer}]}. Return {items:[...]} where items are sorted descending numeric quantity; preserve original order for equal quantities. One response per line; invalid shape returns {error:'invalid_input'} and continues.
tasks.acceptance: Input/output protocol and stable-descending semantics in public_input; tests include ties, empty list and invalid input.

tasks.public_input: Implement JSON-lines handler for {op:'validate_order',quantity:integer}. Return {accepted:true} for integer quantity >=1; otherwise {accepted:false}. Booleans are not integers for this contract. Invalid object returns {accepted:false}. Continue per line.
tasks.acceptance: Exact response shape and boundary behavior as specified publicly.

tasks.public_input: Implement JSON-lines handler for {op:'transition',from:string,to:string}. Only open→resolved is accepted and returns {accepted:true,status:'resolved'}. All other transitions return {accepted:false,status:<original from>}. Invalid object returns {accepted:false}. Continue per line.
tasks.acceptance: Exact state transition and invalid-transition response protocol as specified publicly.

tasks.public_input: Implement JSON-lines handler for {op:'render',title:string,body:string}. Return {text:title+'\n'+body}. Missing/non-string title or body returns {error:'invalid_content'}. Continue per line.
tasks.acceptance: Exact output/error shape as specified publicly.
